Laba – Travel Tracker

Privacy Policy

Last updated: May 19, 2026

This Privacy Policy explains how Laba – Travel Tracker ("we", "our", or "us") collects, uses, and protects your information when you use the Laba mobile application.

1. Information We Collect2. How We Use Information3. Account Creation4. Third-Party Services5. Analytics and Usage Data6. Data Storage and Security7. Data Retention8. Account and Data Deletion9. Children's Privacy10. Changes to This Privacy Policy11. Contact

1. Information We Collect

Laba is designed to minimize data collection. We may collect and store the following information:

  • Email address (only when creating an account)
  • Basic authentication information
  • Travel information, stamps, trips, and content created inside the app
  • Optional profile information provided by the user

If you choose not to create an account, some data may remain stored only locally on your device.

2. How We Use Information

We use collected information only to:

  • Allow users to sign in securely
  • Sync travel data between devices
  • Save user progress and app content
  • Improve app functionality and stability
  • Provide customer support when needed

We do not sell personal information. We do not share personal information with advertisers or data brokers.

3. Account Creation

Creating an account is optional. Some features, such as cloud synchronization and backup, may require an account.

4. Third-Party Services

Wiles may use trusted third-party services necessary for authentication and data storage, including:

  • Apple Sign In
  • Supabase

These services may process limited technical information required for their functionality.

5. Analytics and Usage Data

Wiles may collect anonymous or limited usage analytics to improve the app experience and features. This may include:

  • Session duration
  • Number of trips created
  • Feature usage
  • Progression and reward statistics
  • General in-app interactions
  • App performance and stability information

This information is used only to improve the functionality, balance, and user experience of the app. We do not sell analytics data to third parties.

6. Data Storage and Security

We take reasonable measures to help protect user information and prevent unauthorized access or misuse. However, no method of electronic storage or transmission over the internet can be guaranteed to be completely secure.

7. Data Retention

We retain account-related information only for as long as necessary to provide the service.

8. Account and Data Deletion

Users can delete their account directly from within the app. Deleting an account will remove associated account data from our systems within a reasonable timeframe.

9. Children's Privacy

Laba is not intended for children under the age required by local laws without parental permission.

10. Changes to This Privacy Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Any changes will be posted on this page with an updated revision date.

11. Contact

If you have questions about this Privacy Policy, you can contact us.
